description: Ask a question about an existing transcript and get an answer from the model, with the transcript as context. SPENDS THE ACCOUNT'S LLM CREDITS — every message is billed against them. If you already hold the transcript text, answering directly is cheaper and usually just as good; this is for when you do not. Pass back the returned conversation_id to continue a thread. Requires `login`.

conversation_id.description: Continue an existing thread. Omit to start a new one.

message.description: The question to ask about the transcript.

name: chat_with_transcript
